label: Corran Design Festival — two drafts of one model
covers: Slide 1 and slide 3 are two differently worded drafts of the SAME logic model, with an impact statement between them. This rebuilds, synthetically, the one document shape known to fail the launch gate: one draft is silently dropped and the item count moves between runs, while pageCoverage.ts should flag the page every time. It is here to MEASURE that, not because a fix is queued — what a two-draft document should produce is a product question still open.

slides.title: City Design Week — Logic Model (draft A)

columns.heading: RESOURCES
items: A design studio donated by Corran Partners for the festival month
Twelve volunteer designers recruited through the guild

columns.heading: ACTIVITIES
items: A ten-day public festival of open studios and workshops
A schools programme visiting sixteen classrooms in advance

columns.heading: OUTPUTS
items: Eighty open studio events staged across the ten days
Sixteen classroom workshops delivered before the festival

columns.heading: SHORT-TERM OUTCOMES
items: Attenders can name a design discipline they had not heard of
Pupils describe design as work someone like them could do

columns.heading: LONG-TERM OUTCOMES
items: The city sustains a year-round audience for design programming

columns.heading: IMPACT STATEMENT
items: City Design Week exists so that every resident of the city can see design as something made by people like them, and can find a way into making it themselves.

slides.title: City Design Week — Logic Model (draft B)

columns.heading: RESOURCES
items: Donated studio space secured for the duration of the festival
A volunteer designer cohort drawn from the local guild

columns.heading: ACTIVITIES
items: Ten days of open studios, talks and hands-on workshops
Advance visits to secondary school classrooms across the city

columns.heading: OUTPUTS
items: Eighty staged events over the festival fortnight
Sixteen schools reached ahead of opening weekend

columns.heading: SHORT-TERM OUTCOMES
items: Visitors leave able to name an unfamiliar design discipline
Pupils see design as a plausible career for themselves

columns.heading: LONG-TERM OUTCOMES
items: A standing city audience for design programming year on year
